verdict.rationale: Supabase documents that every project is a full Postgres database built on open-source tools, and that the whole stack can be self-hosted via Docker Compose for full data control. Together these give a documented exit path onto standard, open infrastructure. Daily backups exist, and a CEO comment notes they are pg_dump-based, but the evidence never shows a user-facing export or download flow, nor how to take Storage files or Auth users out. missing for 10: documented export/download of database dumps, export of Storage objects and Auth data, a migrate-off-Supabase guide, independent hands-on confirmation of leaving.
